Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent enemy sprite for the existing dark-fantasy game. Match chunky stepped pixel blocks, dark warm near-black outlines, muted cream/bone, rust brown, antique brass and charcoal steel palette, upper-left highlights. Single complete isolated enemy, three-quarter battle view toward screen left, no environment or ground shadow. Roughly 112x140 logical pixels enlarged nearest-neighbor to 1120x1400: hard square 10px blocks, 1–2 block outline, 3–7 broad shade bands, no dithering or smooth shading. Up to 32 colors. Fully transparent empty background, fully opaque sprite, no translucent effects or antialiasing. No lettering, UI, border, watermark, labels. Do not add traits, props or weapons absent from source. Weakness elements are metadata, not visual powers.
Source: design/enemies.json enemy shadow_archer, 그림자 궁수, family 14 심연 사냥, mob. Exact appearance: 얼굴 없는 사냥꾼의 그림자. 활만 또렷하다. Actions: 사격, 조준 사격, 그림자 화살. Draw ONE faceless hunter's shadow, with only the bow sharply defined. Featureless shadow face and body; clearly readable bow. No other equipment. Full silhouette with generous transparent margins.
